stage: S4 V8(b) energy budget (cad pre-check with the dyn rev. 19 definitions; dyn final ruling 2026-10-21: pass, dynamics_model.md 5.8)

definitions.residual: R(t) = (E_mech(t) - E_mech(t0)) + D_visc + D_slip - W_motor, E_mech = kinetic + gravity + pad contact springs 1/2 kn delta^2 (geometric) + bushing springs 1/2 kt |d|^2 (after the return mapping)
definitions.check_5: D_slip / sum mu N |delta a| in [1.0, 1.05] (every case)
definitions.recorded: old max |R| / (E_kin0 + max |W_m|); shares bushing_lag (-sum kt (a_new - a_used).dp), bushing_implicit (-sum 1/2 kt |dp|^2), kinetic_implicit (-sum 1/2 dv^T M dv), contact_explicit (+sum 1/2 kn d_delta^2), remainder = R - shares; R(0.25 s) / R_end; bushing events
definitions.D_visc: SMC pads c_n delta_dot_n (delta_n+1 - delta_n) (explicit, clip) + bushings c_t,actual |v_t|^2 dt (c_t,actual = 2 x Chrono input, while on)
definitions.D_slip: sum 1/2 kt (|d_trial|^2 - |d|^2) per yielding return mapping
definitions.kick: 0.5 m/s rigid translation along the floor-plane projection of [0.8, 0.6, 0.0] (ASSUMPTION)
